biggest_catch: Your $100 only posts if the friend fully qualifies for MIDFLORIDA's own $200 or $400 checking incentive - $2,000-$4,000 in direct deposits plus 20-40 debit transactions within 75 days - and the friend cannot share your household.
catches: Referring member must have a MIDFLORIDA checking account; friend must present the referral code/card at account opening.

Friend must open a Free Checking account (Freedom Banking excluded) and qualify for the $200 or $400 checking incentive within 75 days: $2,000-$4,000 cumulative direct deposit + online banking/eStatement/debit card + 20-40 debit transactions.
Friend must not share a household with the referrer; you cannot refer your own or secondary accounts.
Incentive posted to the referring member's account within 90 days, only if the referring account is open and unrestricted.
Offer valid as of September 1, 2026 and may be canceled at any time; incentive reported to the IRS.
